name: Kikyou Momiji
source:
The hospital's cheerful, carefree, positive thinker. But her manners are good, and the patients deeply rely on her. Her mother was a talented doctor, and she herself matches her mother's skills. Together with the protagonist, there are big expectations for the future.

[Based on the [url=http://www.oaks-soft.co.jp/princess-soft/21twoone/21chara.html]official site[/url]]
